body: Dr. Meera, compliance heads-up — DCI revised radiograph dose limits effective 2026-12-15 (Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04). Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Digital RVG sensors unaffected. That's 233 days from today. Suggested move: audit your X-ray setup before Dec 15; document E-speed or RVG in your SOPs. Team ke liye 1-page checklist bana doon? Reply YES.
rationale: Regulation change with a deadline: digest item 'd_2026W17_dci_radiograph' (Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04) anchored with its own numbers; category-relevant; single low-effort YES.
